title: Diagonal tensor legs detect morphisms from a separately preserved colimit
statement:
Let $(\mathcal C,\otimes,\mathbf1)$ be a monoidal category [def-sfb-monoidal-category]. Let $I$ be a small nonempty category such that for every pair of objects $i,j$ there are an object $k$ and morphisms $i\to k$ and $j\to k$. No equalization condition on parallel arrows is assumed. Let $X:I\to\mathcal C$ be a functor and $(A,(c_i:X(i)\to A)_{i\in I})$ a colimit cocone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Assume the following image cocones are colimit cocones:

1. For every $i\in I$, the cocone on $j\mapsto X(i)\otimes X(j)$ with vertex $X(i)\otimes A$ and legs $\mathrm{id}_{X(i)}\otimes c_j$.
2. The cocone on $i\mapsto X(i)\otimes A$ with vertex $A\otimes A$ and legs $c_i\otimes\mathrm{id}_A$.

Then for every object $T$ and all morphisms $f,g:A\otimes A\to T$, if
$$
f\circ(c_i\otimes c_i)=g\circ(c_i\otimes c_i)\qquad\text{for every }i\in I,
$$
then $f=g$. Thus the diagonal tensor legs $c_i\otimes c_i$ are jointly epimorphic, meaning exactly the displayed test for equality of morphisms with domain $A\otimes A$.
